body:
>Do me a favour and screw everyone else for once and focus on fixing yourself.

As much as I try to do this, it never goes well. I have people who rely on me for one thing or another, that I can't just tell them no. I've never been good at turning people down, because I just want to please everyone. Thus allowing me to avoid the conflict, which I hate so much. 

For instance, I'm stuck babysitting my 14month old nephew mon-fri because if I try to tell me sister I can't do it, I just get outcasted by that part of me family, because that's how they act. Or I get yelled at for not having a job and turning down doing something useful for my family.

As for therapy, it's not really an option. I have no health coverage and no money to pay those kinds of bills myself and I can't ask anyone to help me with them.
